claims.text: The Romanos sits by the Ionian Sea in the Navarino Dunes area of Costa Navarino.

findings.quote: Enjoying a privileged position by the Ionian Sea in the Navarino Dunes area of Costa Navarino

claims.text: All rooms at the hotel are pet-friendly.

findings.quote: You're welcome to bring your furry friend along, as all our Costa Navarino hotel rooms are pet-friendly.

claims.text: Accommodations have sea, golf or garden views, and many have a private infinity pool facing the Ionian sunset.

findings.quote: All accommodations reveal timeless elegance and alluring sea, or golf and garden views, whereas many integrate a private infinity pool placed against the captivating Ionian sunset.

claims.text: The Romanos Ionian Exclusive suites and villas come with 24/7 butler service.

findings.quote: The Romanos Ionian Exclusive features an elite bouquet of suites and villas
Comfortable and delightful with contemporary stylish design and an exclusive series of amenities, including 24/7 Butler service

claims.text: Royal Villa Methoni is built with native stone and local design elements, right on The Dunes Beach.

findings.quote: Nestled by the sparkling Ionian Sea and built using native stone and incorporating local design elements, Royal Villa Methoni stands regally on the golden The Dunes Beach.

claims.text: Anazoe Spa treatments draw on ancient beauty practices and the teachings of Hippocrates.

findings.quote: The Anazoe Spa offers a serene sanctuary with specialty treatments based on ancient beauty practices and the teachings of Hippocrates

claims.text: Guests can play four signature golf courses at Costa Navarino.

findings.quote: golfers can enjoy four signature courses at our Costa Navarino golf resort

claims.text: The Mouratoglou Tennis Center has tennis, padel and pickleball courts.

findings.quote: the center offers 12 brand new Tennis Courts, 3 Padel Courts & 2 Pickleball Courts.

claims.text: Barbouni serves seafood lunches by the beach beside the Ionian Sea.

findings.quote: Savor a seafood lunch by the beach, with freshly caught fish and signature delicacies served beside the crystal clear Ionian Sea.

claims.text: The hotel has a gym, health center and indoor pool.

findings.quote: Our Costa Navarino spa hotel is equipped with a gym, health center and indoor pool.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the resort is aimed at couples, with plunge pools in nearly all its ground-floor rooms.

findings.quote: aimed squarely at couples, with poolside cabanas and plunge pools in nearly all its ground-floor rooms

claims.text: The Romanos has low-slung buildings wrapped around a series of lit lagoons.

findings.quote: with low-slung buildings wrapped around a series of seductively lit lagoons

claims.text: The Ionian Exclusive beachfront villas have a private pool, sea views and direct access to The Dunes Beach.

findings.quote: ten exceptional beachfront Villas
with personalized services, a private pool, clear sea views and direct access to The Dunes Beach.

claims.text: Anazoe Spa offers signature therapies and oleotherapy treatments inspired by the health and beauty practices of ancient Greece.

findings.quote: Rejuvenate at the multi-awarded 4000m2 Anazoe Spa with a full range of signature therapies and oleotherapy® treatments inspired by the health and beauty practices of ancient Greece.

claims.text: The Mouratoglou Tennis Center at Navarino Dunes is the first European location of Mouratoglou Tennis Center, with courts overlooking the Ionian Sea.

findings.quote: The first European location for a Mouratoglou Tennis Center offers the opportunity to play on brand new, state-of-the-art courts with breathtaking views of the Ionian Sea
Located in the Navarino Dunes area of Costa Navarino, Mouratoglou Tennis Center

claims.text: The Dunes Course, the first signature golf course in Greece, was designed by Bernhard Langer with European Golf Design.

findings.quote: the impressive seaside Dunes Course is the first signature golf course in Greece, designed by two-time US Masters Champion and former Ryder Cup Captain Bernhard Langer in association with European Golf Design.

claims.text: The resort sits among olive and citrus groves and rolling hills, beside a kilometre-long stretch of golden sand on the Ionian Sea.

findings.quote: Nestled in a pristine landscape of olive and citrus groves, native flora and gently rolling hills, fringed by a kilometre-long stretch of golden sand washed by the sparkling waters of the Ionian Sea

claims.text: Messinia is a remote corner of the southwest Peloponnese, about a four-hour drive from Athens or one hour from Kalamata airport.

findings.quote: Messinia is a ravishingly remote corner of the southwest Peloponnese that’s a four-hour drive from Athens (or one hour from tiny Kalamata airport)

claims.text: The rooms do not have a work space.

findings.quote: No, the rooms at The Romanos, a Luxury Collection Resort, Costa Navarino do not have a work space.

claims.text: Navarino Agora, the open-air dining, shopping and culture hub, sits near both The Romanos and The Westin Resort Costa Navarino.

findings.quote: Located at Navarino Bay, near The Romanos and The Westin Resort Costa Navarino, Navarino Agora is an open-air destination uniting gastronomy, shopping, culture, and lifestyle in a vibrant coastal setting.
